summary: Private deployment: IdP issuer hostname with trailing dot causes tenant lookup failures and 403s for service accounts
description: Issue summary: After an IdP metadata refresh, BrightBox started getting 403s when invoking private inference endpoints using service accounts. The error is reproducible for all users in the tenant; web console access also returns 403. Impact: production traffic for BrightBox is blocked, causing customer-facing features to fail. Environment: Private deployment (customer-managed control plane) in eu-west-1. Recent changes: customer updated their IdP metadata earlier today to include a trailing dot on the issuer hostname (e.g. https://idp.brightboxanalytics.com.).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Acquire SAML/OIDC metadata from IdP that uses trailing dot in issuer URL
2) Attempt token exchange/service-call against private control plane in eu-west-1
3) Observe 403 responses and tenant lookup failure in identity-proxy logs
4) Confirm that removing the trailing dot from the issuer in customer's IdP metadata resolves the 403s
observed_behavior: API calls return 403 Unauthorized for all tokens issued by the customer's IdP after metadata refresh
identity-proxy logs show 'no tenant matched issuer' warnings and failed service-account binding checks
Customer reports sudden breakage coincident with metadata change
expected_behavior: Tokens from the customer's IdP should match tenant mappings even if issuer hostname contains a trailing dot
Service account and user role bindings should continue to authorize valid requests
logs: auth-proxy[2026-03-10T08:12:34Z] WARN tenant-resolver: no match for issuer 'https://idp.brightboxanalytics.com.'
auth-proxy[2026-03-10T08:12:34Z] ERROR auth: authorization denied for principal 'svc-account@brightbox' - tenant not found

kubectl -n redwood logs identity-proxy-0 | grep issuer -A2:

comments: 2026-03-10 09:05 - Support (Aisha): Opened ticket after customer's support rep reported 403s across their fleet. Collected IdP metadata and initial logs.

2026-03-10 10:20 - SRE (Miguel): Reproduced in staging by uploading metadata with trailing dot; observed tenant-resolver failure. Confirmed quick workaround is to canonicalize issuer in customer's metadata to remove trailing dot.

2026-03-10 13:30 - Customer (BrightBox): We applied the IdP metadata change as part of routine rotation; urgent to restore service. Asked for ETA on permanent fix so we can re-enable metadata format on our side.

2026-03-11 08:45 - Engineering (Nadia): Hypothesis: canonicalization routine in tenant-resolver normalizes hostnames inconsistently between stored tenant entries and incoming tokens (trailing dot stripped on storage but not on runtime lookup). Will add unit test and patch to normalize by punycode+rstrip('.') and lowercase hostnames consistently.

2026-03-12 11:12 - Support (Miguel): Provided mitigation steps to BrightBox (see workaround). Scheduled code patch and backport to 1.8.x branch; requested customer confirm when they reapply metadata so we can validate.
2026-03-12 16:00 - Customer: Confirmed workaround applied and services restored; requested follow-up to avoid future regressions.
investigation_notes: Reproduced in internal staging by importing SAML metadata with issuer ending in '.'

Tenant storage pipeline previously normalizes issuer when creating tenant entries; observed normalization removed trailing dot during initial onboarding but runtime lookup path didn't apply same rstrip('.') canonicalization in all code paths

Root cause: inconsistent hostname normalization across tenant-registration and runtime-issuer-match code paths. Edge case with trailing dot (valid DNS) not accounted for. Also noticed case-insensitive mismatch for uppercase hostnames in one code path.

Trace: identity-proxy -> tenant-resolver -> tenant-store lookup returned nil using raw incoming issuer. When we manually normalized incoming issuer via rstrip('.') and lowercased host, lookup succeeded.
Related artifacts: reproduced with small test harness (tests/tenant_resolver_trailing_dot_test.go). See PR linked above.
workaround: Temporary workaround provided to customer: update IdP metadata to remove trailing dot in issuer (or add an alternate issuer without trailing dot) and restart metadata push. Support also supplied small reverse-proxy rewrite rule for customers that cannot edit IdP metadata immediately: rewrite issuer header to strip trailing '.' before reaching identity-proxy.
next_steps: 1) Engineering to land canonicalization patch in identity-proxy to normalize issuer hostnames by lowercasing and rstrip('.') for all runtime lookup paths (PR in review)
2) Backport fix to supported stable releases (1.8.x and 1.7.x) and prepare patch release notes
3) Add unit/integration tests to cover trailing-dot and mixed-case issuer hostnames
4) Add a short entry to private runbook with detection query and recommended quick mitigations
5) Coordinate with BrightBox to reapply original metadata after patch lands and validate end-to-end
resolution_notes: Patch created to normalize issuer hostnames across tenant registration and runtime lookup; awaiting review and backport plan. Customer restored service using workaround; engineering to ship fix in next patch release. No data loss. Follow-up: add runbook entry and an alert for sudden spike in 'tenant not found' warnings.
